# IPTV USA

> IPTV USA (goldengateiptv.us) is an IPTV USA subscription service: 50,000+ live TV channels and 200,000+ movies and series on demand, streamed in up to 4K over the internet to Smart TVs, Amazon Firestick, Android, iPhone, iPad, Apple TV, MAG boxes, Windows and Mac. No contract, no dish, free 24-hour trial.

## Key facts

- Service type: IPTV subscription for US viewers (also works abroad)
- Live channels: 50,000+ (US and international entertainment, sports, movies, news, kids, music)
- On demand: 200,000+ movies and series
- Quality: SD, HD, FHD and 4K
- Features: 7-day catch-up, electronic program guide (EPG), Anti-Freeze technology, 24/7 WhatsApp support
- Prices (1 device): 1 month $9.99 · 3 months $25 · 6 months $39.99 · 12 months $69.99 ($5.83/month) · 24 months $119
- Extra connections: 1 to 4 devices per subscription
- Free trial: 24 hours, no credit card, activated via WhatsApp
- Recommended internet: 10 Mbps for HD, 25 Mbps for 4K
- Compatible apps: TiviMate, IPTV Smarters Pro, GSE Smart IPTV, any M3U / Xtream Codes player
- Contact: WhatsApp +212 707 711 512 · goldengateiptv@gmail.com
